title: jired config result
description: A single configuration value; or, for `config path` and `config edit`, the file

file.description: config path and config edit: the config file

exists.description: config path: whether the file exists yet

edited.description: config edit: the file was opened and saved

values.description: Every value of a list setting, after `config add`/`remove`

changed.description: Whether `config add`/`remove` actually altered the list

rewritten.description: Issue files `config add`/`remove ignored_custom_fields` brought into line with the new list, in a workspace

warnings.description: Things worth knowing that did not stop the command
